games.blurb: The one every horror game is still chasing. Twenty-five years on, nothing comes close.
Mr. X is somewhere in the police station, and you can hear every single footstep.
The Baker family has invited you to dinner. You don't get to say no.
Cut off the limbs, not the head. The Ishimura is still the scariest ship in gaming.
One alien you can't kill, and it learns exactly where you like to hide.
Half detective story, half nightmare, and a writer trapped inside his own book.
No weapons and no fighting back. Just you, the dark and a lantern running low.
Survival horror the way the PS1 did it, with a story that stays with you for weeks.
A cosy fishing game, right up until the fog rolls in and the catch stares back.
Eight friends, one mountain, and every choice you make decides who sees sunrise.
